overview: TGIIC (Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation) is a Telangana Government initiative established in 2014 to provide infrastructure through the development of industrial areas, including developed plots/sheds, roads, drainage, water, power, and social infrastructure like worker housing. It coordinates with agencies for communication, transport, and other facilities, and undertakes projects in Public-Private Partnership mode. TGIIC develops industrial parks across all districts of Telangana and develops industrial clusters based on demand and product availability, utilizing Government of India grants under the MSE-CDP scheme for new cluster development and upgradation of existing industrial parks.
objectives: Identify and develop potential growth centers in Telangana
Provide fully equipped industrial plots/sheds with infrastructure (roads, drainage, water, power)
Provide social infrastructure such as housing for workers near industrial zones
Coordinate with agencies for communication, transport, and other facilities
Undertake projects in Public-Private Partnership mode
Develop industrial parks in all districts of Telangana
Develop industrial clusters based on demand and product availability
Utilize Government of India grants under MSE-CDP for new cluster development and upgradation of existing industrial parks
eligibility: The individual will have to submit a downloaded application form which was already filled in online, duly signed by the applicant or authorized person, together with valid documents in original at the Head Office/Zonal Office.
benefits: Access to developed industrial plots/sheds with infrastructure (roads, drainage, water, power), social infrastructure like worker housing, coordination for communication and transport facilities, and opportunities in Public-Private Partnership projects.
financial_support: TGIIC utilizes Government of India grants under the MSE-CDP scheme for developing new industrial clusters and upgrading existing industrial parks; however, specific financial support amounts or mechanisms for individual beneficiaries are not detailed in the evidence.
application_process: 1. Download the application form and fill it in online. 2. Sign the filled application form duly by the applicant or authorized person. 3. Submit the signed application form along with valid documents in original at the Head Office or Zonal Office. 4. The Sub-committee (with members from TGIIC, TSPCB, SFC, Commissioner of Industries, APITCO, technical consultants) will scrutinize the DPR and related documents and recommend the extent of land for allotment. 5. The State Level Allotment Committee (formed with the same members) will approve, defer, or reject the application based on recommendations. 6. The applicant will receive the decision on the same day through their registered mobile.
caveats: Land allotment is subject to scrutiny and approval by the Sub-committee and State Level Allotment Committee
The applicant must submit documents in original at Head Office/Zonal Office
Decision is communicated via registered mobile on the same day
